aliases: コルディリネ・フルティコサ

light.best.quote: This plant requires bright indirect light to maintain its bright foliage colors.

light.min.reason: 出典に暗い場所（Deep shade）への耐性の記載がないため、明るい日陰の一段下までとした

light.directSun.quote: This plant requires bright indirect light

temperature.minC.quote: does not tolerate temperatures below 50 degrees Fahrenheit

temperature.idealC.quote: It does best at temperatures between 65 to 95 degrees Fahrenheit.

watering.growing.quote: allow the plant to dry out a bit between watering

watering.winter.quote: Watering should be reduced from late fall to late winter.

tips.ja: 空気が乾きすぎると葉先が茶色くなる。
tips.quote: The leaf tips will turn brown if the air is too dry.

tips.ja: 鮮やかな葉色を保つには明るい間接光と、年に数回の肥料。
tips.quote: Fertilizing the plant several times a year will also help it to maintain its colors.
